q1.explanationZh: 第二段说他们去过西班牙、法国、意大利、丹麦等国家，所以他们去过丹麦。

evidence.quote: They have been to many places in Spain, France, Italy, Denmark, and other countries.

q2.explanationZh: 照片中 Daniel 是像蜘蛛侠一样“爬”墙，并没有说他打扮成蜘蛛侠。

evidence.quote: One photo shows Daniel “climbing” the wall like Spider-Man

q3.explanationZh: Anna 是假装把红色的建筑“举起来”，好像它是一把红伞，她并没有真的举着红伞。

evidence.quote: another shows Anna pretending to “hold up” the red building as if it were a red umbrella

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段说这对搭档在网上有大量追随者，粉丝们鼓励他们继续努力。

evidence.quote: The pair has a large following on the internet.

q5.explanationZh: 他们利用建筑的形状和颜色拍出有趣的照片，与建筑“玩”在一起，并乐于与世界分享这份快乐，所以说法正确。

evidence.quote: they interact with the shapes and colours of buildings. Their playful photos will make you look twice and smile.
They love sharing their joy with the world.
